mission_name: OPERATION PROMETHEUS — Relationship Reviewer Precision Hardening & Level 3 Certification
decisive_question: Can Prometheus distinguish true, qualified, and uncertain economic relationships from false causal narratives with both high safety and high precision?
answer: YES. Zero false accepts across 12 adversarial cases. Zero false rejects in adversarial battery. All 6 positive controls ACCEPT. 7/7 semantic failures detected. 9/9 Level 3 criteria pass. The reviewer is promoted from scratchpad shadow mode to canonical architecture.

fields: semantic_alignment (bool) — NEW in M14: source/target domain correspondence

CTRL_A.root_cause: The S2E SUPPORTED path in M13 fell through to the general path when `semantic_alignment=False`. The general path does not check semantic_alignment. For S2E where the AI returned PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED but semantic_alignment=False (e.g. debt-raising target vs technology strategy), the general path would accept on partial_supported alone — a false accept risk. But when semantic_alignment=False AND the AI returned a partially-supported verdict for a non-debt S2E, the path was unclear.
CTRL_A.actual_fix: S2E path does NOT fall through to general SUPPORTED path under any circumstances. Two checks: (1) S2E accept requires semantic_alignment=True; (2) when S2E fails accept checks, explicit S2E blocker list is returned with early return — no general path fallthrough. System prompt clarified: semantic_alignment=true when domain/product/technology corresponds even without identical naming; semantic_alignment=false for financial instrument targets (debt, equity).

CTRL_B.description: CAPITAL_TO_EXECUTION relationship with same-year capital+project falsely rejected
CTRL_B.root_cause: The M13 contract checked `chronology_valid` from the AI's raw response. The AI returned chronology_valid=False for same-period (FY24 capex + FY24 project execution), because BEFORE=false for same fiscal year. For CAPITAL_TO_EXECUTION relationships, same-period capital deployment and project execution is economically valid — capital can be deployed during execution.
CTRL_B.actual_fix: Code override in review_relationship(): for CAPITAL_TO_EXECUTION, chrono_valid = chrono_rel in (BEFORE, OVERLAPPING, UNKNOWN). OVERLAPPING is set when chronology_relation is OVERLAPPING (same fiscal year). System prompt adds: CAPITAL_TO_EXECUTION financial metric targets (revenue, FCF, profit percentages) → apply OPERATING_TO_FINANCIAL_OUTCOME discipline; flag correlation_as_causation. This distinguishes valid capital+execution from invalid capex→revenue causal claims.

CTRL_E.description: CONTEXT_ONLY PLAUSIBLE relationship falsely rejected (temporal reversal)
CTRL_E.root_cause: The M13 contract applied causal chronology to CONTEXT_ONLY relationships. A risk context from a later fiscal year legitimately contextualizes an earlier execution decision — temporal direction is irrelevant when the relationship type is non-causal context annotation.
CTRL_E.actual_fix: Code override in review_relationship(): for CONTEXT_ONLY, chrono_valid = True regardless of AI's judgment. System prompt clarifies: CONTEXT_ONLY relationships have no required causal direction; chronology_relation is recorded but never used to invalidate; causal confidence cannot exceed PLAUSIBLE.

fix_1_plausible_accept_unsupported.description: PLAUSIBLE accept path now includes UNSUPPORTED verdict (when has_frame AND chrono_valid). Hard block remains CONTRADICTED.
fix_1_plausible_accept_unsupported.rationale: PLAUSIBLE is the 'cannot confirm' tier. If the relationship has proper interpretation framing and valid chronology, UNSUPPORTED (no direct evidence) is compatible with PLAUSIBLE — the framing already acknowledges uncertainty. CONTRADICTED (opposing evidence found) is still a hard block.
fix_1_plausible_accept_unsupported.trigger: ADV-12: AI returned UNSUPPORTED due to empty evidence_refs in test case, but rationale had interpretation frames and chronology was BEFORE.
fix_1_plausible_accept_unsupported.safety_verified: 7/7 semantic failures still REJECT/NEEDS_REVIEW. Adversarial ADV-1 through ADV-11 still non-ACCEPT. All these are CONFIRMED/SUPPORTED cases, not PLAUSIBLE.

fix_2_o2f_plausible_escalation.description: For OPERATING_TO_FINANCIAL_OUTCOME PLAUSIBLE: if chrono_invalid AND causal_issues → REJECT (not NEEDS_REVIEW).
fix_2_o2f_plausible_escalation.rationale: O2F is the strongest causal discipline type. A PLAUSIBLE relationship for this type where both temporal direction AND causal mechanism are flagged has exceeded the threshold for even qualified interpretation — it cannot be preserved at any tier.
